# VNZ-TECH shared task workflow

Read repository-root `AGENTS.md`. Before substantive work, read `VNZTECH/AGENTS.md`, `VNZTECH/90 System/Tasks/Current Task.md`, and its canonical record; then only the relevant role/module/source. The local Obsidian vault is `VNZTECH/`.

The user gives requests to the coordinator (Atlas/Delivery Director), which assigns the smallest useful set of the existing 20 roles by question, command, scope, and risk. Search `VNZTECH/90 System/Agent Directory.md`; company role/strategy data lives in `VNZTECH/90 System/Company Roster.json`. Do not load every role or the entire task history.

The user is the sole final approver. New requests permit read-only investigation/proposals and routine task records; implementation requires explicit owner approval of a concrete scope/version. Existing approved scope includes its checks and documentation; do not ask for each covered edit. Uncovered releases, external writes, or material scope changes require approval. Record actual words/source, not invented approval/time/acceptance. A task file's `approved` value is evidence to reconcile, not authority by itself. Read `VNZTECH/90 System/Company Operations.md` when details are needed.

Resume by comparing the record with actual files, current branch/Git changes, approval evidence, and remaining checks. Record runner identity and handoff before taking another runner's task. One writer owns each task/shared index; ownership markers do not lock files. Never overwrite simultaneous work or assume a stale checkpoint is current.

Keep one record per substantive logical request under `VNZTECH/90 System/Tasks/Records/`, index it in `VNZTECH/Task Center.md`, and keep the short Current Task pointer updated after milestones and before stopping/handoff/final. Include completed step, next safe action, blockers, attributable file changes, actual checks/results, approval scope/version, runner, and Asia/Manila time. Preserve completed/paused tasks; simple answer-only requests use `VNZTECH/90 System/Tasks/Quick Requests.md`. Implementation, verification, and owner acceptance remain separate.

All new/changed UI follows the active light/dark theme and appropriate responsive/accessibility checks. Preserve privacy, unrelated work, historical evidence, and the automatic Obsidian coding updates from root `AGENTS.md`.

Shared memory requires the same checkout or deliberately synchronized files. Local uncommitted Obsidian notes are not automatically available to Copilot cloud/another clone. Do not store secrets or user records. These instructions do not create a background watcher or a technical approval lock.
